WITH RECURSIVE
items AS (
    SELECT set_num AS item_num, 'set'::VARCHAR AS item_type
    FROM sets
    UNION ALL
    SELECT fig_num AS item_num, 'minifig'::VARCHAR AS item_type
    FROM minifigs
),
current_inv AS (
    SELECT item_num, item_type, inventory_id
    FROM (
        SELECT i.item_num,
               i.item_type,
               inv.id AS inventory_id,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY i.item_num, i.item_type
                   ORDER BY inv.version DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM items i
        JOIN inventories inv
          ON inv.set_num = i.item_num
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
edges AS (
    SELECT ci.item_type AS parent_type,
           ci.item_num  AS parent_num,
           'set'::VARCHAR AS child_type,
           s.set_num AS child_num,
           s.quantity AS qty
    FROM current_inv ci
    JOIN inventory_sets s
      ON s.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id

    UNION ALL

    SELECT ci.item_type AS parent_type,
           ci.item_num  AS parent_num,
           'minifig'::VARCHAR AS child_type,
           m.fig_num AS child_num,
           m.quantity AS qty
    FROM current_inv ci
    JOIN inventory_minifigs m
      ON m.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
),
tree AS (
    SELECT 'set'::VARCHAR AS item_type,
           '45801-1'::VARCHAR AS item_num,
           1::BIGINT AS qty,
           ['set:45801-1'] AS path

    UNION ALL

    SELECT e.child_type,
           e.child_num,
           t.qty * e.qty,
           list_append(t.path, e.child_type || ':' || e.child_num)
    FROM tree t
    JOIN edges e
      ON e.parent_type = t.item_type
     AND e.parent_num = t.item_num
    WHERE NOT list_contains(t.path, e.child_type || ':' || e.child_num)
),
total AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ip.quantity * t.qty), 0) AS total_qty
    FROM tree t
    JOIN current_inv ci
      ON ci.item_type = t.item_type
     AND ci.item_num = t.item_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip
      ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
),
direct AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ip.quantity), 0) AS direct_qty
    FROM current_inv ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip
      ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    WHERE ci.item_type = 'set'
      AND ci.item_num = '45801-1'
      AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
)
SELECT ROUND(
           100.0 * (total_qty - direct_qty) / NULLIF(total_qty, 0),
           2
       ) AS percentage
FROM total, direct;

current_comp AS (
    SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, version, child_kind, child_num, color_id, qty, is_spare
    FROM u_composition
    QUALIFY version = MAX(version) OVER (PARTITION BY parent_kind, parent_num)
),
explode(root_set, child_kind, child_num, color_id, qty, is_spare) AS (
    SELECT
        s.set_num,
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_num,
        c.color_id,
        c.qty,
        c.is_spare
    FROM sets s
    JOIN current_comp c

    WHERE s.year = 2019

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        e.root_set,
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_num,
        c.color_id,
        e.qty * c.qty,
        c.is_spare
    FROM explode e
    JOIN current_comp c
      ON c.parent_kind = e.child_kind
     AND c.parent_num = e.child_num
    WHERE e.child_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM explode e
WHERE e.child_kind = 'part'
  AND e.child_num = '3941'

    AND parent_num = '10785-1'

  FROM u_explosion
  WHERE root_kind = 'set'
    AND root_num = '10785-1'
    AND is_current
    AND item_kind = 'part'
    AND NOT is_spare
),
direct_part_qty AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.qty), 0)::DOUBLE AS qty
  FROM u_composition c
  JOIN cur_ver v ON c.version = v.version
  WHERE c.parent_kind = 'set'
    AND c.parent_num = '10785-1'
    AND c.child_kind = 'part'
    AND NOT c.is_spare
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * (total_part_qty.qty - direct_part_qty.qty) / total_part_qty.qty,
  2
) AS pct_from_nested_sets_and_minifigs
FROM total_part_qty, direct_part_qty;
